adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the line `contents << "\n<hr>..."` appends to the passed-in `contents` String in place, which is a real side effect on caller-owned data (Ruby Strings are mutable and `<<` mutates). However, in the shown call sites the argument is typically a fresh String (e.g., `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` in `Jobs::PollFeed`, and `doc.content` in `import_remote` is immediately consumed), so the diff does not demonstrate an actual broken behavior—it's a maintainability/edge-case concern rather than a verifiable defect.
